{
  "name": "game-hint",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Hint",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "The hint line under the prompt adds what to press now: ESC 후퇴 while working, /compact 휴식 at low HP, 오류부터 읽기 after repeated failures, /save 세이브 when a save is due",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-hint",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "hints",
    "footer",
    "context"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "off adds nothing; casual adds one or two hints; hardcore also counts the failures",
      "default": "casual",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "casual",
        "hardcore"
      ]
    },
    "lowHp": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Low HP (%)",
      "description": "Suggest /compact when context left drops to this percent",
      "default": 25,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 60
    },
    "saveEvery": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Save every (turns)",
      "description": "Suggest /save after this many turns without one (needs game-save-point)",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100
    }
  }
}
